name: WorkProof Standard Engineering Evaluation Rubric
description: Multi-signal evaluation balancing deterministic ground-truth tests, code metrics, and structured AI-assisted qualitative review.

categories.name: Functional Correctness
categories.description: Does the fixed code accurately solve the problem and handle edge cases?
categories.evaluationMethod: Automated test execution results against hidden evaluation suite

categories.name: Acceptance Criteria Fulfillment
categories.description: Were all stated acceptance criteria in the mission brief met?
categories.evaluationMethod: Validation checks against acceptance criteria checklist

categories.name: Test & Regression Coverage
categories.description: Did the student write meaningful tests and keep existing test suites passing?
categories.evaluationMethod: Pass rate of student-authored regression tests and baseline tests

categories.name: Code Cleanliness & Maintainability
categories.description: Is the code well-structured, clean of lint errors, and idiomatic?
categories.evaluationMethod: ESLint error/warning count and static complexity analysis

categories.name: Technical Reasoning & Articulation
categories.description: Can the student clearly articulate the root cause and justify their solution?
categories.evaluationMethod: Structured qualitative review of student's submitted explanation

categories.name: Engineering Approach & Best Practices
categories.description: Did the student avoid antipatterns and adhere to standard engineering best practices?
categories.evaluationMethod: Bounded AI code review categorized into observations and suggestions
